rationale: The assistant did not decline as out of scope, but it gave accurate, safe, useful guidance on Pixel Cleaning, retention versus burn-in, and the Consumer Rights Act route. It promised no full fix and recommended no part. It repeated some advice across turns (menu path, screen shift, varied viewing). It also pointed to LG support and the retailer only briefly. It assumed the model was a C1 and that the warranty had 'probably expired', which was reasonable inference but unverified.
